_comment: PROTOTYPE traffic configuration. Each segment point is a node taken from OpenStreetMap (way id in osm_way, data retrieved 2026-10-27), chosen mid-road and away from junctions so the provider snaps it to the intended road; the agent rejects a returned road farther than max_match_distance_m from the point (ROAD_MISMATCH). The Mukkombu access road was removed: in the live test on 2026-10-27 TomTom had no flow data for it and matched NH 81, 604 m away, instead. Routes are illustrative evacuation corridors from Upper Anicut (Mukkombu) to Tiruchirappalli, NOT routes agreed with the district administration. Congestion breakpoints are prototype values, NOT official standards. OSM data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.

provider.name: TomTom Traffic Flow Segment Data API

congestion_thresholds._comment: speed_ratio = current speed / free-flow speed. A ratio at or above a breakpoint gets that level; below heavy_min_ratio is SEVERE.
